description: A curated and opinionated list of resources for Chief Technology Officers, with the emphasis on startups

summary.one_liner: A curated, opinionated list of links and reading resources for Chief Technology Officers and VP R&D, emphasizing startups and hyper-growth companies.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style list of links rather than a software project. It is organized into sections such as CTO Position, Hiring, People Management, Career Growth, Project Management, Handbooks, Development Process, Architecture, Technologies, Data, Startups, Due Diligence, Money/Finance, Product, Marketing, and Books. Most entries are titled links to blog posts, Quora answers, company handbooks, or other GitHub awesome-lists, with the author or company noted in parentheses. Coverage includes hiring and interviewing, managing engineering teams, performance reviews, technical debt, postmortems, microservices versus monoliths, cloud and data team structure, equity and fundraising, and technical due diligence. The README contains no code and no install steps.
use_cases: Finding reading material on becoming or working as a CTO
Researching engineering hiring and interview practices
Looking up engineering management and performance review guidance
Preparing technical due diligence for a startup
Reviewing architecture and development process trade-offs
Learning about startup equity and fundraising for engineering leaders
notable: Curated reading list organized by CTO responsibility area, from hiring to finance
Links to well-known handbooks such as Valve, Basecamp, GitLab, and HashiCorp
Points to many other awesome-lists on GitHub, including CTO, CEO, TPM, and product management lists
Licensed CC0-1.0, so content can be reused freely
caveats: Entries are external links only; the README does not summarize their content, and many may be dated
Opinionated selection with an emphasis on startups, so it may be less relevant for large established companies
Some entries are Quora threads or social media-style pieces of uneven quality
